_comment: Drop a copy of this at <workspace>/.cc/config.json fields (flake_retries + flake_whitelist) to control flake handling. The skill reads these per project.
_comment_flake_retries: Number of times to re-run JUST the failing tests before declaring red. Default 2. Set to 0 to disable retry.
_comment_flake_whitelist: Fully qualified test names that should fail-soft (log + continue) rather than trigger bug-driven TDD. Match the format your runner emits.
